using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;

ll X, Y, N;

double error(ll den, ll num) {
    return abs(den * X - num * Y) / (Y * (den + 0.0));
}

int main() {
    cin >> X >> Y >> N;
    ll a = 0, b = 0, ta;
    double mn = 214748364.0f;

    for (ll tb = 1; tb <= N; ++tb) {
        ta = (tb * X) / Y;
        double t = error(tb, ta);
        if (t < mn) {
            a = ta;
            b = tb;
            mn = t;
        }
        ++ta;
        t = error(tb, ta);
        if (t < mn) {
            a = ta;
            b = tb;
            mn = t;
        }
    }

    ll l = (ll)sqrt(max(a, b) + 0.0);
    for (ll i = 2; i < l; ++i)
        while (a % i == 0 && b % i == 0) {
            a /= i;
            b /= i;
        }

    cout << a << '/' << b << endl;
    return 0;
}
